code_evidence.behavior: PublicResponse returns data.results[0].response.data as json.RawMessage; it does not validate Facebook data fields.
wrapGatewayBody wraps POST input in arguments; gatewayPublicResponse invokes the Composio projection. Treg takes the default response path.
Executor reads upstream body bytes and applies Connect normalization only for a Connect binding.
Explicit public route mappings distinguish five Composio POST routes from three Treg GET routes.

source_boundaries: Current Composio public metadata was fetched with version=latest; its output wrapper was projected through the reviewed PublicResponse code. This is not proof of the deployed session's exact metadata version.
The complete immutable Runtime acquisition and a fresh current-pointer read have the same artifact revision. The application image revision was not independently verified.
No production database, response normalization or provider configuration was changed.
